aiResearchSummary.text: HeyCharge is researching systems for authenticating users at charging devices and reporting usage, as described in 'System for authenticating a user at and reporting about use of a charging device.' The abstract details an authenticating and reporting system utilizing a database unit and cryptography module to sign or encrypt authentication, aligning with their focus on charging infrastructure and payment systems. Their R&D centers on secure user authentication and usage reporting for electric vehicle charging.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $2,960,801, or 37.91% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $2,960,801, representing 37.91% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,072,798 to $26,081,165, a 24.31x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
